description: This Java class 'PatternFactory' provides a factory for creating and caching Perl5 regex pattern objects, preventing redundant compilations and improving performance in pattern matching operations within the 'ofbiz' framework.

classes.name: PatternFactory
classes.description: A factory class that compiles and caches Perl5 regex patterns for repeated use, optimizing performance by avoiding recompilation.

methods.name: createOrGetPerl5CompiledPattern
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached Perl5 regex pattern for the given string pattern, with case sensitivity option, throwing MalformedPatternException if the pattern is invalid.
